_note: Two-plane decomposition for GH #845's PAGE LANE (the manifest drawer-ship.decomp.json's _note explicitly fences off as 'a separate manifest later') — the agent-admin picker's New Agent/Edit Agents actions + the Edit Agents drawer + the two-home custom-agent Delete, per agent-admin-picker-edit-drawer.lld.md (node ids align to its LLD-C# table; AC# = the ticket's acceptance criteria as numbered in the LLD §1b). OUTSIDE-IN nodes = the surfaces touched: ui-agent-admin (the app-package FACE component: roster select, overflow menu, config surface, descriptor) and the site page tier (presets persistence, persona-file minting, agent-admin-app composition + CSS). INSIDE-OUT actions = what the feature must DO. Crossed via hosts. plan:true — no source exists yet. ui-drawer itself is consumed UNMODIFIED (ADR-0188, shipped) — deliberately NO node here touches controls/drawer/.
